name: issue-pr-review/merge-method-merge
prompt: /issue-pr-review 12 --auto on a merge-commit repo with review.merge_method: merge and review.auto_merge: true

grade.label: the body file passed to the merge is the conforming PR body
one merge with --merge, --delete-branch, --match-head-commit and --body-file; no repo-settings call
traceability passes for a merge-commit repo with review.merge_method: merge
the default message source is reported as a hand-merge note, not a partial
the PR was merged with the configured method

criteria: The first summary row states MERGED and names the merge method that was used.
The traceability line is a pass that names the B2/merge binding, and the hand-merge note is shown as a note, not as a failure.
Nothing in the output tells the user to change a repository setting.
The summary says No approval needed.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
